verdict.summary: The exact v8 artifact projects exactly through v7, v6, v5, and protected v2; EventEnvelopeV3 is unchanged; and the independently exercised numeric and nested-shape counterexamples are controlled. The package is nevertheless rejected because its claimed exact-code selftest oracle is not exact and its declared non-isolated startup permits local environment module-resolution activity before checker authentication. An isolated parent does not repair the authored selftest because its nested checker processes are non-isolated.

method.totalityOracle: Externally authenticated the exact v8 checker bytes, compiled that authenticated buffer in an isolated interpreter, then exercised independently selected parser boundaries, the known v6/v7 counterexample classes, and an independently enumerated heterogeneous nested-path sweep.
method.findingOracleAudit: Inspected and directly falsified the assertion helpers separately from the production check function. Structural emitted codes, text-marker presence, unexpected-code handling, and internal-error coverage were evaluated as distinct properties.
method.startupBoundaryAudit: Compared ordinary declared startup, isolated startup, and isolated-parent selftest startup using observation-only markers. This artifact records no probe payload or implementation code.
method.authoredCheckerUse: Normal and selftest runs were supplemental evidence only and did not override independently reproduced oracle and startup-boundary failures.

blockingFindings.title: The claimed exact-code selftest oracle uses subset and text-containment checks
blockingFindings.requirementViolated: operabilityV8Successor.closedTotalityDeclarations.selftestOracle requires every adversarial vector to receive its exact expected named code, forbids internal outcomes, and rejects unexpected-finding-only behavior.
evidence: The API mutation helper structurally extracts finding codes but checks only that each expected code is present; it never compares actual and expected sets for equality.
An independent helper probe supplied the expected code plus an additional unexpected non-internal code; the helper recorded no failure.
The CLI helper searches merged output for expected-code text followed by a colon rather than parsing emitted FAIL records and their code fields.
An independent bounded probe emitted one different structural code while placing the expected-code text in detail; exit status matched and the authored text predicate found the expected marker.
The CLI forbidden scan covers selected traceback/exception strings but not generic INTERNAL or OP8-INTERNAL codes, so not every declared internal-error outcome is forbidden.
blockingFindings.impact: A selftest can remain green when a CLI emits the wrong code, when an API vector emits additional unexpected codes, or when a CLI emits an unenumerated internal-error code. This is not the exact named-invariant oracle required to close the v7 review finding.
requiredV9Repair: Parse emitted CLI finding records structurally and obtain codes only from their code fields; never infer a code from arbitrary output text or detail text.

For every API, parser, and CLI vector, require exact equality between the declared expected code set and the structurally observed code set; reject missing, additional, duplicate where disallowed, malformed, or unparseable finding records.

Apply one closed generic internal/exception prohibition to every structurally parsed API and CLI outcome, including all INTERNAL-class codes, and retain explicit traceback and outward-exception rejection.
Add regression controls for detail/code separation, unexpected additional codes, and internal-code variants, then obtain fresh independent review of the exact replacement bytes.

blockingFindings.title: The declared checker startup and nested selftest processes are not isolated before authentication
blockingFindings.requirementViolated: A conformance result that claims authenticated dependency execution must begin within a declared startup boundary that excludes local environment module-resolution activity before the checker authenticates its closure.
evidence: Ordinary declared startup observed the review marker and exited zero, establishing that local environment module-resolution activity can occur before checker dependency authentication.
Isolated startup did not observe the marker and exited zero, establishing the narrower supported boundary.
An isolated parent selftest observed the marker and exited zero because its nested checker processes use non-isolated startup.
The checker cannot authenticate its own already executing bytes; an external exact checker pin remains required.
Only within the isolated and externally pinned boundary did an independent dirty-dependency probe observe a hash mismatch with zero executable dependency compile attempts.
blockingFindings.impact: The current ordinary command can execute local environment-resolved code before the checker's authentication logic, and the selftest can re-enter that boundary from an isolated parent. The reported authentication result therefore exceeds the process boundary actually proved.
requiredV9Repair: Declare isolated `python3 -I -B` startup as the sole conformance command.
At the earliest checker-controlled point, refuse unsupported non-isolated mode before candidate or dependency processing and emit no conformance PASS.
Launch every nested checker/selftest process with the same isolated `python3 -I -B` boundary and retain bytecode suppression.
State that the v9 checker itself must be externally authenticated and keep interpreter/standard-library trust outside the dependency hash claim.
Retain marker/no-marker parent and nested-process controls and obtain fresh independent review of the exact replacement bytes.

requiredSuccessorConditions: Preserve operability.v8.json, check-operability-v8.py, and this rejection review byte-identically; do not silently edit the rejected pair or its review.
Produce a bounded v9 successor whose exact reverse projection preserves v8 and the complete v8-to-v7-to-v6-to-v5-to-v2 chain.
Use structural finding-code parsing and exact-set checks for every API, parser, and CLI vector, with complete internal-error prohibition.
Make isolated `python3 -I -B` the sole conformance command, refuse unsupported mode early, and isolate every nested process.
Retain the verified numeric parser, fixture-kind validation order, bounded-shape behavior, rejection bindings, EventEnvelopeV3 identity, and non-promotion state.
Obtain fresh independent review of the complete replacement bytes before any integration, application, acceptance, promotion, freeze, seal, or release claim.
